classification.difficultyReason: Students work backwards through the pyramid. They must choose a solving order and subtract signed integers at each step, with four unknowns chained from the top and the given cells. This is more than routine but needs no unsignposted insight.

content.prompt: Complete the pyramid. Each rectangle is the sum of the two rectangles directly below.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}
\text{Third row, right}&=-12-(-5)\\&=-12+5\\&=-7\\
\text{Second row, middle}&=-5-(-3)\\&=-5+3\\&=-2\\
\text{Second row, right}&=-7-(-2)\\&=-7+2\\&=-5\\
\text{Bottom row, third}&=-5-2\\&=-7\\
\text{Bottom row, second}&=-2-(-7)\\&=-2+7\\&=5\\
\text{Bottom row, first}&=-3-5\\&=-8
\end{align*}$$
